t: The last man in, told three times that it is not full
a: اذْهَبْ فَادْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ . فَيَأْتِيهَا فَيُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهَا مَلأَى فَيَرْجِعُ فَيَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ وَجَدْتُهَا مَلأَى
p: Idhhab fa-dkhuli-l-jannah. Fa-yaʾtīhā fa-yukhayyalu ilayhi annahā malʾā, fa-yarjiʿu fa-yaqūlu yā rabbi wajadtuhā malʾā
m: Go and enter the Garden. So he comes to it and it seems to him that it is full, and he goes back and says: my Lord, I found it full.
